identificationModule.briefTitle: A Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Pitolisant in the Treatment of EDS in Patients With OSA
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Multicenter Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Pitolisant in the Treatment of Excessive Daytime Sleepiness in Patients With Obstructive Sleep Apnea

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The objective of this study is to demonstrate the efficacy and safety of pitolisant versus placebo during 12 weeks of the Double Blind period, to treat the Excessive Daytime Sleepiness (EDS) in patients with Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA) not tolerating or refusing the nasal Continuous Positive Airway Pressure (nCPAP) therapy or treated by nCPAP but still complaining of EDS.

armGroups.label: Pitolisant
armGroups.description: Histamine H3 receptor H3R antagonist/ inverse agonist

interventions.name: Placebo oral tablet
interventions.description: Matching placebo tablets will be provided for each strength of active pitolisant film-coated tablets.
